#### INTRODUCTION These Terms of Service (ToS) contain legal terms and conditions that govern the use of services provided to you by Art While Apart, also referred to in these ToS as "we,”, "our,", and "us.”. By using our services, you agree to be bound by Section I: General Terms, which contains provisions applicable to all users requesting art, including visitors to the Art While Apart website and social media. If you choose to apply as a team member of Art While Apart, you agree to be bound by additional terms set out in Section II of the ToS.
#### Section I: General Terms
1. Project Overview Art While Apart is a collaborative effort between digital artists. We connect pet owners with digital artists to deliver a pet portrait. Moreover, we collaborate with animal rescue services to promote their animals for adoption through pet portraits. The service provided by Art While Apart is on an "as available" basis. We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue the service at any time and without notice. Furthermore, every submission  gets reviewed and we reserve the right to refuse requests based on our discretion.You agree that Art While Apart is and will not be liable for any modification, suspension, or discontinuance of the service.
2. Creative Visions Art While Apart consists of intermediate level artists with varying digital art styles. Artists are free in their creative expression. You agree to accept the artist's creative vision. We ensure that animals from rescue organizations are portrayed in a positive light. 
3. Delivery, Distribution, and Use The artworks are made free of charge for personal use only. The artists themselves own the rights to their artwork, Art While Apart does not claim any legal nor unique right to the artist and their art. The works are provided digitally by e-mail only. You may not reproduce, distribute, publicly display, or prepare derivative works based on any of the artwork without accordingly crediting the appropriate owner and/or the express written consent of the appropriate owner.
4. Timeline Art While Apart works on a voluntary basis and does not hold strict deadlines on artwork. There is a queue in place with priority given to team members of Art While Apart.
5. Donations Art While Apart maintains equal opportunities for artists and does their best effort to provide a donation link for the artist responsible for a given artwork. Art While Apart will display our own donation link only after agreement of the artist. Donations to Art While Apart are used directly for the maintenance of the services.

You are allowed to use the artwork for private personal use, which can include printing the artwork to display in your home. The artist holds the right to use their artwork in their portfolio and other self-promotion. You cannot claim different authorship of their intellectual property. When submitting the Digital Pet Portrait Request form, you agree and warrant that you will have sufficient rights to upload the materials, and that you will not upload any material protected by copyright or other intellectual property rights without the express permission of the rights holder. You are solely liable for any damages resulted from uploading materials in the Digital Pet Portrait Request form of which you have not acquired express permission from the respective rights holder. You will indemnify Art While Apart when third parties assert legally binding claims against us due to violation of their intellectual property rights on the uploaded materials.  By uploading the materials you expressly grant, or warrant that Art While Apart and our artists have been expressly granted, a non-exclusive,  royalty-free, irrevocable worldwide license to use, reproduce, display online in any present or future media, to make derivative works out of the materials and to reproduce and display online the derivative works on websites, communications and other (future) media.
7. Conditions You accept the artist's creative vision. Art While Apart does not provide any revisions or resubmissions of the same pet. Any request of modifications to the artwork has to be agreed upon by the artist, only by them, and is done purely out of their own goodwill. You are not allowed to modify their intellectual property without the express written consent of the artist.
8. Disclaimer Art While Apart is not liable for any damages that arise from the use of our services, including, but not limited, to waiting time incurred by long queues. Art While Apart makes no representations or warranties of any kind to the operation of the services.

You acknowledge and agree that Art While Apart is not responsible or liable for the availability and accuracy of these websites or resources. #### Section II: Additional Terms
16. Art While Apart Team Art While Apart manages a community of digital artists, providing a platform to interact, share, and grow. Art While Apart makes use of third party software, websites, and resources to maintain our community.
17. Application Art While Apart has [requirements ](https://www.artwhileapart.org/join-us)for prospective applicants and reserves the right to modify or suspend [these requirements](https://www.artwhileapart.org/join-us), at any time and without notice. When applying it is required that you acknowledge and agree to the requirements of Art While Apart. Art While Apart has introduced a learning program - Bean program - for applicants who were close to meeting these requirements. We reserve the right to reject any application at our discretion.
18. Submitting Content As a member, you will have access to participate in the community's chat rooms as part of the services. Furthermore, you will have the option to participate in the consultation of Art While Apart and provide pet portraits. There is no required activity as a member; all is on a free and voluntary basis. Pet portraits can range from headshots to full body pieces with background; there is no limit or minimum placed upon the pet portraits. However, the art has to resemble the pet and has to be the same animal / species. Furthermore, copyrights and intellectual properties have to be respected and the content has to be original.

20. Monitoring and Conduct Art While apart uses their best efforts to monitor their brand, services, and third party products and services. You agree to be subject to and conduct yourself in accordance with the [house rules](https://www.artwhileapart.org/house-rules). You are responsible for all of the content and material you transmit through our services. Art While Apart reserves the right to modify and delete content.

As a member, you acknowledge and agree to handling data in accordance with the [privacy policy](https://www.artwhileapart.org/privacy-policy). You are not allowed to save or distribute data outside its intended purpose without express written consent from the data subject.
23.
